classification_vocabulary.parallel-eligible-current-scopes: The current exact targets are disjoint, so separately admitted work may run concurrently under the listed conditions.
classification_vocabulary.serialize-or-refresh: The lanes touch a common target, semantic contract, baseline, or integration surface and require one exact order or a fresh plan.
classification_vocabulary.unknown-block: The exact target inventory is absent or stale, so parallel execution is not admissible.

global_rules: Parallel eligibility is scheduling evidence only; every lane still needs its own current acceptance, selection, mutation admission, and owner prerequisites.
Compare exact regular-file targets, not directory names, team names, or Git status.
Rehash live baselines immediately before each admitted unit and block on a newly appeared, drifted, missing, or overlapping target.
Use isolated worktrees or equivalent output isolation; keep temporary files, tests, and evidence namespaces attempt-specific.
A shared package directory does not force serialization when exact targets and semantic contracts are disjoint.
A shared package manifest, export index, common EVF schema, adapter, handle contract, or exact output does force serialization or fresh reconciliation.
Provider fan-out begins only after the common property/projection contract is immutable; joins run only after all selected terminal receipts exist.
Relationship Design, contract compilation, packet acceptance, executable-contract acceptance, downstream plan refresh, and provider execution are separate serialized edges.
No later successful cleanup or sibling validation may mask an earlier failed acceptance-critical command.
